<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.selected_configuration: explicit static module profile; not a runtime observation

sourceFacts: Two FCNet projections are separate owned parameter families; external w is a two-axis pair weight input, not a learned module parameter.
einsum contracts both visual and question positions; k3 feature factors then pool by AvgPool1d and multiplication by3, which implements sum-pooling.
This method does not use BCNet.dropout(.5), h_mat or h_bias; attention-generation and pooling examples do not imply shared instances.
Graph ranks only allocate space. Explicit edges supply real operands; no upstream code is imported or executed.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
